Democrats for Congress in Lehigh Valley meet in first debate | PHOTOS By Monica Cabrera | mcabrera@mcall.com | The Morning Call PUBLISHED: April 2, 2026 at 12:24 AM EDT | UPDATED: April 2, 2026 at 12:29 AM EDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... The four Democratic candidates for Congress in the Lehigh Valley made their case to voters in a televised debate that will air in two parts beginning next week. The debate was hosted by Greater Lehigh Valley Chamber of Commerce CEO Tony Iannelli on Moravian University’s campus.
WFMZ’s “Business Matters” hosts a debate between Democratic candidates for the 7th Congressional District, Pennsylvania Fire Fighters Association President Bob Brooks, former Northampton County Executive Lamont G. McClure, former PPL engineer Carol Obando-Derstine and former federal prosecutor Ryan Crosswell on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at Moravian University in Bethlehem.
